programme.title: The Zoo: The Kings of Queens
programme.desc: A trio of new penguin chicks are introduced to the pool for their first swim family dynamics change when the mandrill monkey troop welcomes a new baby a pair of king vultures are prepped for their big debut at the Queens Zoo.

programme.title: My Cat From Hell: Sister Smackdown
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, Jackson helps a cat named Charlee rebuild the confidence that her sister cat, Frankie, has nearly beaten out of her The Cat Daddy must crack the case of a pee-soaked apartment in order help a family with multiple cats.

programme.title: I Was Prey
programme.desc: Andrea Schlake volunteers at an animal sanctuary when a chimpanzee escapes its enclosure and chases her down a great white shark knocks surfer Todd Endris off his board and attacks him.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Bosco the Croc's Big Move
programme.desc: Robert takes on the challenging task of relocating Bosco, the most aggressive croc at the zoo Bindi must investigate Forest the giraffe's bad knee problem Terri helps Harley the koala find love at the end of a difficult breeding season.

programme.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Cat Men to the Rescue
programme.desc: After a team effort to rescue Bear the cat, Shaun goes solo on a night mission to find the cat, Spaz, that has been missing for three weeks a call about a feral cat in a woman's backyard leads to danger.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R.: The Heart of the Conflict
programme.desc: Investigating a string of murdered lions, Ivan gets to the very heart of an ancient conflict between humans and lions. The outcome will test Ivan's own core values about cultural perspective and conservation.

programme.title: Sharkcam Strikes Back
programme.desc: From napping great white sharks to SharkCam attacks, a showcase of the remarkable discoveries made by the team in the past six years as well as a tongue-in-cheek look at some of the disasters.

programme.title: The Zoo: Snow Monkey Social
programme.desc: A new bison calf has a hard time keeping up with his mom the bird department prepares a group of Von der Decken hornbill chicks for their move to the Minnesota Zoo keepers at the Central Park Zoo hope the female snow monkeys accept a new male.

programme.title: My Cat From Hell: Ferocious Foster
programme.desc: Jackson meets an outdoor cat who, having been forced to live inside, has protested by soaking the place in pee a desperate foster guardian resorts to Jackson as her only hope to save a cat from being euthanized.

programme.title: I Was Prey
programme.desc: A grizzly bear charges taxidermist Wilf Lloyd while he hunts elk with his son-in-law in the Canadian Rocky Mountains miles from shore, diving 180 feet below the surface, spearfisher Anthony Segrich finds a bull shark charging toward him.
